setup: DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends php-cli php-curl php-mbstring php-xml php-gd php-zip php-intl php-sqlite3 php-bcmath
warmup: php -r '$key = "base64:".base64_encode(hash("sha256", getenv("APP_KEY"), true)); file_put_contents(".env", preg_replace("/^APP_KEY=.*/m", "APP_KEY=".$key, file_get_contents(".env")));' && unset APP_KEY && php artisan koel:init --no-interaction --no-assets --no-scheduler
install: php -r '$key = "base64:".base64_encode(hash("sha256", getenv("APP_KEY"), true)); file_put_contents(".env", preg_replace("/^APP_KEY=.*/m", "APP_KEY=".$key, file_get_contents(".env")));' && unset APP_KEY && php artisan koel:init --no-interaction --no-assets --no-scheduler

app.cmd: unset APP_KEY; exec php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port="$PORT"

web.cmd: exec node --input-type=module -e 'import { createServer } from "vite-plus"; const publicUrl = new URL(process.env.VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL); const server = await createServer({ server: { host: "0.0.0.0", port: Number(process.env.PORT), strictPort: true, origin: publicUrl.origin, cors: { origin: process.env.APP_URL }, hmr: { host: publicUrl.hostname, protocol: "wss", clientPort: 443 } } }); await server.listen(); server.printUrls();'
